9/G.goal: Explain the major issues and challenges of VR and AR, from the ambiguity of presence and fidelity constraints in VR to the display, interaction, and pose registration/tracking challenges in AR.
9/G.achieves: It provides a foundation for understanding the user-facing and technological limitations of XR systems, supporting later design and implementation of XR applications.

9/O1.goal: Explain why the goal of presence in VR is ambiguous and how the uncanny valley effect, together with representational, interaction, and experiential fidelity, shapes design trade-offs for realistic VR experiences.
9/O1.achieves: It lets the learner evaluate VR experiences and design decisions by understanding the perceptual and experiential constraints that affect presence and immersion.

9/O2.goal: Describe the main technological challenges of AR systems across display technology, interaction modalities, and three-dimensional pose registration and tracking.
9/O2.achieves: It lets the learner identify the technical problems an AR developer must address to align and sustain virtual content within the real environment.
